info.name: MenuPilot — Flutter Mobile
info.description: Source-checked requests for customer, staff and delivery apps. Import an environment. Cookies are required for real accounts; no JSON login token. Business writes are skipped unless allow_writes=true. This is a catalogue, not a run-all scenario: acceptance/rejection, pickup/delivery, sign-out and different roles are alternatives. Read API.md and select one workflow on staging.

item.name: Create delivery — review zone minimum first

request.description:
Set a real test zone and available item. Server prices win. quantity=2 may not meet every zone minimum. Do not automatically retry after timeout.

Middleware: api, throttle:10,1
Source: App\Http\Controllers\OutsideOrderController@place

Auth: public

body.raw:
{
  "type": "delivery",
  "name": "زبون اختبار",
  "phone": "{{customer_phone}}",
  "address": "عنوان اختبار — لا ترسل لمطعم حقيقي",
  "zone_id": {{zone_id}},
  "notes": "طلب تكامل تجريبي",
  "payment_method": "cash",
  "items": [
    {
      "menuItemId": {{menu_item_id}},
      "quantity": 2,
      "note": "بدون بصل",
      "options": []
    }
  ]
}
